description: This Java class implements a strategy to handle FeaturePropertiesCreated events within the Eclipse Ditto framework, updating a ThingBuilder with feature properties from the event.

classes.name: FeaturePropertiesCreatedStrategy
classes.description: A final class that extends AbstractThingEventStrategy to handle FeaturePropertiesCreated events and update the state of a ThingBuilder accordingly.

methods.name: applyEvent
methods.description: Overrides the method to handle FeaturePropertiesCreated events by setting feature properties on the ThingBuilder.
